verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
verses.english: Indeed We sent Noah to his people, [saying,] ‘Warn your people before a painful punishment overtakes them.’
verses.transliteration_html: Inna arsalna noohan ila qawmihi an anthir qawmaka min qabli an yatiyahum AAathabun aleemun
verses.transliteration_text: Inna arsalna noohan ila qawmihi an anthir qawmaka min qabli an yatiyahum AAathabun aleemun

verses.arabic: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
verses.english: He said, ‘O my people! Indeed, I am a manifest warner to you.
verses.transliteration_html: Qala ya qawmi innee lakum natheerun mubeenun
verses.transliteration_text: Qala ya qawmi innee lakum natheerun mubeenun

verses.arabic: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.english: Worship Allah and be wary of Him, and obey me,
verses.transliteration_html: Ani oAAbudoo Allaha waittaqoohu waateeAAooni
verses.transliteration_text: Ani oAAbudoo Allaha waittaqoohu waateeAAooni

verses.arabic: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.english: that He may forgive you some of your sins and respite you until a specified time. Indeed when Allah’s [appointed] time comes, it cannot be deferred, if you know.’
verses.transliteration_html: Yaghfir lakum min thunoobikum wayuakhkhirkum ila ajalin musamman inna ajala Allahi itha jaa la yuakhkharu law kuntum taAAlamoona
verses.transliteration_text: Yaghfir lakum min thunoobikum wayuakhkhirkum ila ajalin musamman inna ajala Allahi itha jaa la yuakhkharu law kuntum taAAlamoona

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًۭا وَنَهَارًۭا
verses.english: He said, ‘My Lord! Indeed, I have summoned my people night and day
verses.transliteration_html: Qala rabbi innee daAAawtu qawmee laylan wanaharan
verses.transliteration_text: Qala rabbi innee daAAawtu qawmee laylan wanaharan

verses.arabic: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًۭا
verses.english: but my summons only increases their evasion.
verses.transliteration_html: Falam yazidhum duAAaee illa firaran
verses.transliteration_text: Falam yazidhum duAAaee illa firaran

verses.arabic: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَـٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًۭا
verses.english: Indeed whenever I have summoned them, so that You might forgive them, they would put their fingers into their ears and draw their cloaks over their heads, and they were persistent [in their unfaith], and disdainful in [their] arrogance.
verses.transliteration_html: Wainnee kullama daAAawtuhum litaghfira lahum jaAAaloo asabiAAahum fee athanihim waistaghshaw thiyabahum waasarroo waistakbaroo istikbaran
verses.transliteration_text: Wainnee kullama daAAawtuhum litaghfira lahum jaAAaloo asabiAAahum fee athanihim waistaghshaw thiyabahum waasarroo waistakbaroo istikbaran

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًۭا
verses.english: Again I summoned them aloud,
verses.transliteration_html: Thumma innee daAAawtuhum jiharan
verses.transliteration_text: Thumma innee daAAawtuhum jiharan

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًۭا
verses.english: and again appealed to them publicly and confided with them privately,
verses.transliteration_html: Thumma innee aAAlantu lahum waasrartu lahum israran
verses.transliteration_text: Thumma innee aAAlantu lahum waasrartu lahum israran

verses.arabic: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًۭا
verses.english: telling [them]: ‘‘Plead to your Lord for forgiveness. Indeed, He is all-forgiving.
verses.transliteration_html: Faqultu istaghfiroo rabbakum innahu kana ghaffaran
verses.transliteration_text: Faqultu istaghfiroo rabbakum innahu kana ghaffaran

verses.arabic: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًۭا
verses.english: He will send for you abundant rains from the sky,
verses.transliteration_html: Yursili alssamaa AAalaykum midraran
verses.transliteration_text: Yursili alssamaa AAalaykum midraran

verses.arabic: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍۢ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍۢ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَـٰرًۭا
verses.english: and aid you with wealth and sons, and provide you with gardens and provide you with streams.
verses.transliteration_html: Wayumdidkum biamwalin wabaneena wayajAAal lakum jannatin wayajAAal lakum anharan
verses.transliteration_text: Wayumdidkum biamwalin wabaneena wayajAAal lakum jannatin wayajAAal lakum anharan

verses.arabic: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًۭا
verses.english: What is the matter with you that you do not look upon Allah with veneration,
verses.transliteration_html: Ma lakum la tarjoona lillahi waqaran
verses.transliteration_text: Ma lakum la tarjoona lillahi waqaran

verses.arabic: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
verses.english: though He has created you in [various] stages?
verses.transliteration_html: Waqad khalaqakum atwaran
verses.transliteration_text: Waqad khalaqakum atwaran

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍۢ طِبَاقًۭا
verses.english: Have you not seen how Allah has created the seven heavens in layers,
verses.transliteration_html: Alam taraw kayfa khalaqa Allahu sabAAa samawatin tibaqan
verses.transliteration_text: Alam taraw kayfa khalaqa Allahu sabAAa samawatin tibaqan

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًۭا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًۭا
verses.english: and has made therein the moon for a light and the sun for a lamp?
verses.transliteration_html: WajaAAala alqamara feehinna nooran wajaAAala alshshamsa sirajan
verses.transliteration_text: WajaAAala alqamara feehinna nooran wajaAAala alshshamsa sirajan

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًۭا
verses.english: Allah made you grow from the earth, with a [vegetable] growth.
verses.transliteration_html: WaAllahu anbatakum mina alardi nabatan
verses.transliteration_text: WaAllahu anbatakum mina alardi nabatan

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًۭا
verses.english: Then He makes you return to it, and He will bring you forth [without fail].
verses.transliteration_html: Thumma yuAAeedukum feeha wayukhrijukum ikhrajan
verses.transliteration_text: Thumma yuAAeedukum feeha wayukhrijukum ikhrajan

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًۭا
verses.english: Allah has made the earth a vast expanse for you
verses.transliteration_html: WaAllahu jaAAala lakumu alarda bisatan
verses.transliteration_text: WaAllahu jaAAala lakumu alarda bisatan

verses.arabic: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًۭا فِجَاجًۭا
verses.english: so that you may travel over its spacious ways.’’ ’
verses.transliteration_html: Litaslukoo minha subulan fijajan
verses.transliteration_text: Litaslukoo minha subulan fijajan

verses.arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
verses.english: Noah said, ‘My Lord! They have disobeyed me, following someone whose wealth and children only add to his loss,
verses.transliteration_html: Qala noohun rabbi innahum AAasawnee waittabaAAoo man lam yazidhu maluhu wawaladuhu illa khasaran
verses.transliteration_text: Qala noohun rabbi innahum AAasawnee waittabaAAoo man lam yazidhu maluhu wawaladuhu illa khasaran

verses.arabic: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًۭا كُبَّارًۭا
verses.english: and they have devised an outrageous plot.
verses.transliteration_html: Wamakaroo makran kubbaran
verses.transliteration_text: Wamakaroo makran kubbaran

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّۭا وَلَا سُوَاعًۭا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًۭا
verses.english: They say, ‘‘Do not abandon your gods. Do not abandon Wadd, nor Suwa, nor Yaghuth, Ya‘uq and Nasr,’’
verses.transliteration_html: Waqaloo la tatharunna alihatakum wala tatharunna waddan wala suwaAAan wala yaghootha wayaAAooqa wanasran
verses.transliteration_text: Waqaloo la tatharunna alihatakum wala tatharunna waddan wala suwaAAan wala yaghootha wayaAAooqa wanasran

verses.arabic: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًۭا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَـٰلًۭا
verses.english: and already they have led many astray. Do not increase the wrongdoers in anything but error.’
verses.transliteration_html: Waqad adalloo katheeran wala tazidi alththalimeena illa dalalan
verses.transliteration_text: Waqad adalloo katheeran wala tazidi alththalimeena illa dalalan

verses.arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٔـٰتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًۭا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًۭا
verses.english: They were drowned because of their iniquities, then made to enter a Fire, and they did not find any helpers for themselves besides Allah.
verses.transliteration_html: Mimma khateeatihim oghriqoo faodkhiloo naran falam yajidoo lahum min dooni Allahi ansaran
verses.transliteration_text: Mimma khateeatihim oghriqoo faodkhiloo naran falam yajidoo lahum min dooni Allahi ansaran

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
verses.english: And Noah said, ‘My Lord! ‘Do not leave on the earth any inhabitant from among the faithless.
verses.transliteration_html: Waqala noohun rabbi la tathar AAala alardi mina alkafireena dayyaran
verses.transliteration_text: Waqala noohun rabbi la tathar AAala alardi mina alkafireena dayyaran

verses.arabic: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًۭا كَفَّارًۭا
verses.english: If You leave them, they will lead astray Your servants, and will beget none except vicious ingrates.
verses.transliteration_html: Innaka in tatharhum yudilloo AAibadaka wala yalidoo illa fajiran kaffaran
verses.transliteration_text: Innaka in tatharhum yudilloo AAibadaka wala yalidoo illa fajiran kaffaran

verses.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًۭا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا
verses.english: My Lord! Forgive me and my parents, and whoever enters my house in faith, and the faithful men and women, and do not increase the wrongdoers in anything but ruin.’
verses.transliteration_html: Rabbi ighfir lee waliwalidayya waliman dakhala baytiya muminan walilmumineena waalmuminati wala tazidi alththalimeena illa tabaran
verses.transliteration_text: Rabbi ighfir lee waliwalidayya waliman dakhala baytiya muminan walilmumineena waalmuminati wala tazidi alththalimeena illa tabaran
